steps.npc: Do you mind? You're in my home.

steps.player: I'm sorry, should I have knocked?

steps.npc: We can't all live in plush houses, you know. But that doesn't mean us mining dwarves don't work hard.

steps.player: Where do you do your mining?

steps.npc: Normally the coal mine to the north. We need a lot of coal to keep our steam engines going, you know.

steps.player: Can I do a bit of mining there as well?

steps.npc: I'm not sure, but as long as no one notices I don't think anyone is going to care.
